mapper.select: SELECT c.COUNTRY_CODE AS countryCode, c.NAME_KO AS nameKo, s.BIRTHS AS births, s.LIFE_EXPECTANCY AS lifeExpectancy, s.INFANT_MORTALITY AS infantMortality, s.GDP_PER_CAPITA AS gdpPerCapita, s.URBAN_RATE AS urbanRate, s.SEX_RATIO_BIRTH AS sexRatioBirth FROM COUNTRY c JOIN COUNTRY_STAT s ON c.COUNTRY_CODE = s.COUNTRY_CODE WHERE c.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND s.DECADE = #{decade} AND s.BIRTHS > 0
mapper.update: UPDATE LIFE SET STATUS = 'ABANDONED', ENDED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE GUEST_TOKEN = #{guestToken} AND STATUS = 'PLAYING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LIFE ( LIFE_ID, MEMBER_ID, GUEST_TOKEN, START_TYPE, NAME, GENDER, BIRTH_COUNTRY, CURRENT_COUNTRY, BIRTH_YEAR, WEALTH_CLASS, IS_URBAN, HEALTH, HAPPINESS, KNOWLEDGE, RELATION ) VALUES ( #{lifeId}, #{memberId, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{guestToken, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{startType}, #{name}, #{gender}, #{birthCountry}, #{currentCountry}, #{birthYear}, #{wealthClass}, #{isUrban}, #{health}, #{happiness}, #{knowledge}, #{relation} )
mapper.select: SELECT LIFE_ID AS lifeId, MEMBER_ID AS memberId, GUEST_TOKEN AS guestToken, START_TYPE AS startType, NAME AS name, GENDER AS gender, BIRTH_COUNTRY AS birthCountry, CURRENT_COUNTRY AS currentCountry, BIRTH_YEAR AS birthYear, WEALTH_CLASS AS wealthClass, IS_URBAN AS isUrban, CURRENT_AGE AS currentAge, HEALTH AS health, HAPPINESS AS happiness, KNOWLEDGE AS knowledge, RELATION AS relation, STATUS AS status FROM LIFE WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId}
mapper.update: UPDATE LIFE SET CURRENT_AGE = #{currentAge}, HEALTH = #{health}, HAPPINESS = #{happiness}, KNOWLEDGE = #{knowledge}, RELATION = #{relation}, LAST_PLAYED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LIFE_YEAR_LOG ( LIFE_ID, AGE, YEAR_NO, COUNTRY_CODE, HEALTH, HAPPINESS, KNOWLEDGE, RELATION ) VALUES ( #{lifeId}, #{currentAge}, #{birthYear} + #{currentAge}, #{currentCountry}, ROUND(#{health}), ROUND(#{happiness}), ROUND(#{knowledge}), ROUND(#{relation}) )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT COUNTRY_CODE AS countryCode, LIFE_EXPECTANCY AS lifeExpectancy, INFANT_MORTALITY AS infantMortality FROM COUNTRY_STAT WHERE COUNTRY_CODE = #{currentCountry} ORDER BY ABS(DECADE - (#{birthYear} + #{currentAge})) ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
mapper.update: UPDATE LIFE SET STATUS = 'ENDED', DEATH_AGE = #{deathAge}, DEATH_CAUSE = #{deathCause}, ENDED_AT = SYSDATE, LAST_PLAYED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE LIFE_ID = #{lifeId}
